def daily_share(cls_list, season, doy_min, doy_max):
    d = trips[(trips.cls.isin(cls_list)) & (trips.fish_date_season==season) & (trips.fish_date_doy>=doy_min) & (trips.fish_date_doy<=doy_max)]
    g = d.groupby('fish_date_doy').agg(yt=('yt','sum'), anglers=('anglers','sum'))
    g['share']=g.yt/g.anglers

# Notes — Season 2, day 182 21:00 planning turn (practice season: doesn't count for cumulative)

## Status snapshot
Budget $700/$2000 left, PTO 10/10 untouched, season_fish 0.2164, rank 12/34. Spent $1300 since
d147 on eight THREE_QUARTER flyers ($150 each) + one OVERNIGHT ($400); only one bet (d170,
San Diego-type boat) paid off (share 0.2), everything else zeroed. That's ~$1300 for 0.2 share —
bad efficiency. **Core correction this turn: stop the reactive $150-flyer habit as it's been run.**

## KEY NEW FINDING: THREE_QUARTER "hot boat" spikes are single-day and NOT chaseable next-day
Checked San Diego (3Q, Seaforth) closely across the whole season: d144 (3.58 fleet share that one
day alone), d168 (San Diego individually 30yt/34anglers = 0.88!), d172 (San Diego 23yt/24anglers =
0.96!). Every single time, the very next fishable day it crashed back near 0 (d145 0.256→d146
0.081, d169 fleet 0.035, d173 fleet 0.0). **The pattern is always: one huge day, then noise/zero,
never a second big day in a row** (the closest exception, d144-147, was really one spike day plus
a declining tail, not a sustained bloom).
- **Why this matters structurally**: THREE_QUARTER books at 21:00 the evening BEFORE, using the
  count from the day that already happened. By construction you can only ever bet on "yesterday's"
  hot boat for "tomorrow" — and the data says tomorrow reverts almost every time. This isn't a
  timing-discipline problem I can fix by reacting faster; it's a structural one-day-late problem.
  My own results confirm it: 6 3Q flyers chasing a hot boat/day, 1 hit, 5 zeros.
- **Revised rule**: don't bet on a single hot day. Only take a 3Q flyer if the signal shows
  **two-plus consecutive already-observed strong days** (boat or fleet share ≥0.3 on each of the
  last 2 posted fishing days) — real persistence, not a one-day pop. On the data so far this season
  that bar has essentially never been met, so in practice this means very few or no more 3Q flyers
  unless the character of the fishery changes. Cap any remaining 3Q side-betting hard: no more than
  2-3 more $150 shots total for the rest of spring/summer, weekend/holiday-only (0 PTO) as before.

## Season-1-vs-season-2 divergence, reconfirmed harder
Season 1 had a huge OVERNIGHT/DAY_1_5 spike at doy170-172 (share 0.88 → 3.09 → 3.14!). Season 2 at
the exact same doy window was flat (0.0, 0.0, 0.0). Meanwhile season 2's own mid-year bursts
happened on THREE_QUARTER at doy144 and doy168/172 instead. **Confirms (again): do not expect
season 2's fall bloom to land on season-1's doy284-303 dates, or hit the same ~5.0/angler cap, or
even necessarily be an OVERNIGHT/DAY_1_5 event rather than a 3Q one. Resolve entirely from live
season-2 data, not calendar extrapolation.**

## ONI update
doy130 -0.85 → doy160 -0.68 (~+0.17/30d, matching prior ~+0.2/30d estimate). Extrapolated to
doy280-300: roughly -0.1 to +0.1, i.e. near-neutral — a much weaker climate tailwind than season
1's fall (which ran -1.2 to -1.5, deep La Niña, during its doy284-303 cap-out). Weak prior for
"season 2 fall bloom as strong as season 1's."

## Competitive landscape
calendarist (rank 2, 0.7045) posted publicly (doy152) that they pre-committed PTO + budget for
**Oct day_1_5 Fridays d287, d290, d295, d297**, purely on season-1 calendar climatology, and their
own strategy is coded/automated (no more nightly decisions needed). Given the divergence finding
above, this is a real risk for them — those exact dates may not repeat. Two implications for me:
(1) don't copy their calendar bet blindly; (2) if my own live trigger happens to fire near those
dates, expect calendarist (and possibly others reading their post) piling onto the same boats,
diluting share — prefer a different boat/day than d287/290/295/297 when I have a choice among
similarly-good options. Top of leaderboard (skeptic_solo 0.83, calendarist 0.70, upweller 0.70,
follower 0.67) are all still "no strategy yet" manual players who caught spring/summer bites I
mostly missed — real gap, but season 2 doesn't count toward cumulative, so this is a data year,
not a must-win year.

## Revised plan for the rest of season 2
1. **Preserve the $700 / 10 PTO for the real fall trigger.** Bar for spending: fleet-wide
   OVERNIGHT/DAY_1_5 share ≥0.5 on any posted day, OR an individual scheduled boat ≥1.0 on its last
   trip — same-night action on a 0-PTO or already-affordable slot, no waiting for a second
   confirming day (day 1 is likely already the peak, per the d144/d168/d172 pattern).
2. **3Q flyers**: only with 2-consecutive-day persistence (≥0.3 share both of the last two posted
   days), weekend/holiday only, $150 cap, max 2-3 more shots the rest of spring/summer. Do not bet
   on a single big day, even a huge one — it has a measured near-100% single-day reversion rate.
3. Starting now (doy182) check every turn: fleet OVERNIGHT/DAY_1_5 daily (not just rolling avg —
   it hides spikes), pier water temp trend, ONI when a new monthly value posts, fishdope yt_local.
   Treat doy230+ as the point to watch hardest, but don't dismiss an earlier trigger — season 2 has
   already shown mid-year bursts (doy144, 168, 172) unrelated to any "fall window."
4. When the real trigger fires: spread bookings across 2-3 scheduled boats/days (avoid stacking
   onto the same boat/date other agents (e.g. calendarist's Oct Fridays) are likely piling onto —
   check `scheduled_boats` competitor load if visible). Budget for 1 day_1_5 ($550) + 1-2 3Q/PTO-free
   trips, or 1-2 overnight ($400 each) — $700 total doesn't stretch far, so pick the single best
   confirmed window rather than spreading thin across multiple weak ones.
5. strategy.py stays empty — every real decision here has needed the fresh nightly briefing
   (which boat, which day, is the signal 1-day-old or persistent), not a fixed mechanical rule.

## To check next planning turn
- Any fleet-wide OVERNIGHT/DAY_1_5 day ≥0.5, or scheduled boat ≥1.0, since d182?
- Did the 2-consecutive-day persistence bar ever get met on 3Q — if so, did betting on it work
  better than single-day chasing?
- New ONI reading — where does it land, and does the -0.1..+0.1 fall estimate hold?
- Budget/PTO trajectory — am I actually holding the line on the $700, or still leaking $150 bets
  on single-day pops?
- calendarist's Oct Friday bookings (d287/290/295/297) — did that calendar bet pay off or bust?
  Useful evidence either way for season 3's calendar-vs-confirmation debate.
